Features

Everything you need for one confident trip

Live stock at every store

In stock, low stock or sold out, with a count and when it was last updated, so you know how far to trust it.

Crowd and queue levels

See whether a store is quiet, moderate or busy right now before you set off.

Aisle and shelf finder

A simple floor plan shows exactly where the product sits, so you’re in and out in minutes.

Reserve and collect

Hold an item for an hour and show a pickup code at the counter. Someone else can collect it for you.

Similar products

If your first choice is sold out, PeekShop suggests a close alternative that is in stock nearby.

Open now, real hours

Filter to stores that are open and close enough to reach in time, with walking directions.

For shoppers

Go in, grab it, and go.

Specialty products sell out with every shipment. PeekShop tells you which shop has it today, so a fifteen-minute errand stays fifteen minutes.

About PeekShop

Why we built it

The challenge

People who rely on local specialty stores often find out a product is missing only when they’re standing in the shop. Websites are outdated, phone answers aren’t reliable, and a short errand becomes a morning.

Our vision and mission

Make everyday grocery shopping fast and stress-free by showing what’s on the shelf at nearby local stores before you go.

How PeekShop works

Stores share stock by spreadsheet, phone or till system. Every count is time-stamped. Shoppers search, compare, reserve and go, and tell us whether the item was really there.

Good for shoppers, good for local stores

Shoppers save trips. Independent stores get found by nearby customers who want exactly what they stock.
